runnerNotes: Foundry invariant runner only this pass (256 runs x 500 depth = 128000 calls per invariant per strategy). Rate-peg keeps all 7 entry points reverts=0, confirming non-vacuous coverage. Medusa not run this narrow pass; existing test/invariant/Medusa* harnesses cover broader surface.

orphanedValueFootgunVerdict.condition: relinquishPrincipal can drive totalDeposited -> 0 while getTotalShares() > 0, leaving residual vault value with no principal claim

empiricalEvidence.test_orphan_NOT_capturable_via_skim: skimSurplus returns 0 in orphan state because _skimSurplus has `if (td == 0) return 0;` guard — orphan is unskimmable while totalDeposited==0
empiricalEvidence.test_orphan_capturable_by_fresh_deposito: after relinquish of 100e18, a fresh 1e18 deposit yields totalBalanceOf == 101e18 for the fresh depositor (entire position) — orphan attributed to fresh principal
empiricalEvidence.test_orphan_capturable_as_skimmable_surp: after the same 1e18 reseed, skimSurplus delivers ~100e18 (the full orphaned residual) to the recipient as surplus

orphanedValueFootgunVerdict.severityNote: No value is created from nowhere (INV2 holds): the orphaned value originated as the relinquisher's own deposited principal. The footgun is mis-ATTRIBUTION/re-capture: value the relinquisher voluntarily released becomes capturable by (a) the next skimmer, or (b) a fresh depositor whose totalBalanceOf inflates to the whole position. For story-045's intended use (a principal-only client releasing dormant principal so the value flows to yield on recovery), capture-by-skimmer is the DESIGNED behavior. The hazard is the fresh-depositor inflation window if any deposit lands before a skim while td was 0.
